title: The Mermaid Inn

buildingCutout.basis: Approximate occupied eastern part of the wider mapped Mermaid Street row.

terrainReference.basis: Original DEM at the named inn point next to the street frontage.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap inn point and selected portion of the shared row polygon, interpreted using the national listing and cleared courtyard photographs.

identities.name: The Mermaid Inn
identities.address: Mermaid Street, Rye, East Sussex, England

mapIdentity.scope: Named inn point, street axis and selected outline, exact Qualla photo, two supplemental CC0 exterior photographs and original elevation.

note: The south street elevation fans into two black-and-white wing fronts. A cobbled entry leads to a rear timber arch, enclosed yard, pitched tiled roofs, several dormers and brick chimney stacks.
